items.description: S0-AD system with atmospheric/quantum sensing integration

notes: DoW assessment aircraft with quantum sensing payload via SRI Center for Innovation. Ryan Nesselrodt in-person interview with BST team scheduled July 28–29. System integration, payload development, and 60m launch-failure debugging ongoing. Recent Slack/email activity through 2026-07-20 confirms live engagement. Next steps: resolve motor/launch diagnostics before Aug 5 flight test.
